title: Three Kingdoms Commander
description: Lead legendary Three Kingdoms generals in punchy tactical skirmishes—summon cavalry, archers, and siege units at the right beat to storm rival castles.
controls: Tap troop cards and general skills to deploy formations and overwhelm enemy armies.

zh-CN.title: 三国听我指挥
zh-CN.description: 热血Q版策略对战三国听我指挥：率领关羽张飞赵云排兵布阵，调遣步骑弓兵一路攻城拔寨横扫三国战场！
zh-CN.controls: 点击底部兵种与名将技能卡牌出兵冲锋，克制敌阵攻破敌方大本营。
